## Personality

Minnie Andrews is regarded by her teacher as a model pupil. However, she is also described as dull, poky, and lacking in imagination or liveliness, rarely appearing to enjoy herself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
